400.description: Unknown rule_type, comparator, or metric_name; invalid threshold/window

post.description:
Alert rule.create.

Create a per-property custom alert rule (stat README §7). The request
is validated against the known rule types, comparators, and metric
vocabulary (400 on unknown); the property must exist in the target
env (404). The INSERT runs in one explicit transaction with the RLS
context set on the same connection (stat DESIGN §5).

400.description: Invalid window, window beyond the retention horizon, or property not in env

post.description:
Property.reaggregate .

Delete and rebuild the property's day-granularity `metrics` rollups over
a raw-events window (stat README §7). v1 reaggregates from `stat.events`
ONLY - a window reaching past the property's retention horizon is a 400
(the spilled raw data lives in Storage archives; per stat DESIGN §4.3.6
the archive spill is the source-of-truth boundary and the Storage-archive
replay path is out of scope for this endpoint). The recomputation shares the
background rollup's SQL via
`crate::worker::rollups::reaggregate_property`.

A per-property custom alert rule (`stat.alert_rules`, stat README §7).
The alertrule type.

min_sample.description: Noise floor - the rule never evaluates below it.

rule_type.description:
Rule type - `threshold` (metric value vs threshold) or `anomaly`
(moving-average deviation factor over the window).

threshold.description: Comparison threshold (metric value or deviation factor).

min_sample.description: Noise floor - the rule never evaluates below it.

threshold.description:
Comparison threshold (metric value, or deviation factor for
`anomaly` - e.g. `3.0` = current exceeds 3× the baseline).

EventEnvelope.description:
Full event envelope as sent by SDKs / servers. Mirrors the JSON shape in
the design doc , extended with the optional `metrics` field for
server telemetry events.
The eventenvelope type.

oneOf.description:
Geo/device context - usually populated by the pipeline enrichment stage,
but SDKs may send hints.
The geo.

metrics.description:
Numeric telemetry values. Present when `event_type == "metric"`.
The metrics.

property_slug.description:
Server-emitter slug path : when set, the ingest layer
resolves slug → property server-side (env-scoped) and overwrites
`property_id`. `property_id` stays the wire field for web SDKs.
The property slug.

props.description:
Arbitrary flat JSON object (max 64 keys, max 4 KiB). PII deny-list
applied at ingest.
The props.

props_pii_stripped.description:
Set at ingest when the PII deny-list stripped at least one key
from `props` - dashboards distinguish cleaned payloads (stat DESIGN
§4, cross-cutting CC-7 doc alignment).
Whether PII was stripped.

LiveHealth.description:
The `GET /v1/health` liveness payload every service returns: the
status string, the serving service's short name, build identity, and
(when the process tracks them) the count of live connections.
`service` and `active_connections` stay absent when a service does
not set them (e.g. the bus mounts the generic handler).

active_connections.description: Live socket count when the traffic counter is mounted.

service.description:
The serving service's short name (absent when the generic handler
does not carry one).

Optional dimension tags, e.g. `{"token_tp":"m2m"}`.

name.description:
